title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
title_zh: 最小描述长度在自改进科学智能体中无监督地分离法学级知识与统计学级知识——并揭示其自身 86% 的发现属于统计学级

paragraphs.en: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate “laws” at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting : which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent—one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts—already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader . The compression-ranked top band of the agent’s ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities— enrichment p = 3.6 × 10 − 12 p=3.6\times 10^{-12} under a hypergeometric test—with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. The same lens retroactively reveals that 86% of the ledger compresses nothing ( cr ≈ 1 \mathrm{cr}\approx 1 ): the agent had been recording statistical regularities, including a learned predictor with held-out R 2 = 0.541 R^{2}=0.541 admitted through the prediction gate, under a narrative of compression as the unified value of knowledge—a narrative that was never true for them. We formalize the resulting dual-axis bookkeeping —prediction value ( R 2 R^{2} ) and compression value (cr) as nearly decoupled axes of knowledge—demonstrate its robustness to quantization, and register forward falsifiable predictions. The episode is, to our knowledge, the first measured instance of a discovery agent auditing its own knowledge ledger by an internal measure and finding itself over-claiming.
paragraphs.zh: 能够发现科学关系的AI系统如今可以大规模生成候选“定律”，但瓶颈已从生成转向审核：哪些候选值得相信？ 我们证明，一个已部署的自我改进科学智能体——一个已通过留出预测法庭接纳了252条关系的智能体——已经计算出了能回答这个问题的量：用于模型选择的最小描述长度压缩比，在离散记账方式下解读时，可作为无监督的认知评分器。 该智能体账本中按压缩比排序的顶部区间恰好恢复了其发现中的经典定律（七个行星的活力公式、巴尔默/里德伯公式）以及跨测量恒等式——在超几何检验下富集 p = 3.6 × 10 − 12 p=3.6\times 10^{-12}——且零反例，区间结构在物理上连贯一致。 同一视角追溯性地揭示，账本中86%的内容没有任何压缩（ cr ≈ 1 \mathrm{cr}\approx 1）：该智能体一直在“压缩是知识的统一价值”这一叙事下记录统计规律性，包括一个通过预测门槛被接纳、留出 R 2 = 0.541 R^{2}=0.541 的学习型预测器——而这一叙事对这些内容从来都不成立。 我们将由此产生的双轴记账形式化——预测价值（ R 2 R^{2}）与压缩价值（cr）作为知识中近乎解耦的两个轴——证明其对量化的鲁棒性，并登记了前瞻性的可证伪预测。 据我们所知，这一事件是首个被测量的案例：一个发现型智能体用内部度量审计自己的知识账本，并发现自己存在过度宣称。

paragraphs.en: AI systems that discover scientific relations—symbolic regression ( Schmidt and Lipson, 2009 ) , concept-driven law discovery ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , and LLM-based pipelines—now generate candidate “laws” at scale. The binding constraint has quietly shifted from generation to vetting : which of hundreds of admitted candidates deserve belief? The concern is now institutional ( Cornelio et al., 2026 ) , autonomous-research systems draw systematic critique for exactly this gap ( Beel et al., 2025 ) , and the symbolic-regression literature still grades discovery almost exclusively by recovery of known ground-truth formulas ( Matsubara et al., 2022 ) —a retreat made necessary by the absence of any grader that works without ground truth. Human curation does not scale with the output of a machine that never sleeps, and the systems themselves carry no instrument that grades the epistemic status of what they find. A discovery system that cannot tell a law from a strong correlation will bank both under the same heading—and, given enough time, mistake its own statistics for physics.
paragraphs.zh: 能够发现科学关系的AI系统——符号回归（Schmidt and Lipson, 2009）、基于概念的定律发现（Fang et al., 2025）以及基于大语言模型的流水线——如今已能大规模地生成候选「定律」。 真正的瓶颈已悄然从生成转向审查：在数百个被接纳的候选中，哪些值得相信？ 这一担忧如今已是制度性的（Cornelio et al., 2026），自主研究系统正因这一缺口而遭到系统性批评（Beel et al., 2025），而符号回归文献仍然几乎只以能否还原已知的标准答案公式来评价发现（Matsubara et al., 2022）——这一退步之所以不得已，是因为缺少任何无需标准答案即可运作的评判工具。 人工筛选无法跟上一台永不休眠的机器的产出速度，而这些系统自身也不携带任何能够评判其所发现内容之认识论地位的工具。 一个无法区分定律与强相关性的发现系统，会把两者都记在同一个名下——并且，只要时间够长，就会把自己的统计结果误当作物理规律。

paragraphs.en: The system is a self-improving physical-science runtime (companion paper ( Mao and Zou, 2026 ) ). Concretely, it continuously ingests public measurement archives (planetary ephemerides, spectroscopy tables, crystallography databases, climate and geophysical records), proposes parametric relations of the form y ≈ f ⁡ ( x , θ ) y\approx f(x;\theta) between measured variables of one dataset, and admits a relation only if it beats a standard basis on a held-out split—gates vary by court family, typically R 2 ≥ 0.5 R^{2}\geq 0.5 with a margin over the basis. Every admitted relation (“symbol”) enters a persistent ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统是一个自我改进的物理科学运行时（伴生论文 ( Mao and Zou, 2026 )）。 具体而言，它持续摄取公开的测量档案（行星星历表、光谱学数据表、晶体学数据库、气候与地球物理记录），在单个数据集的被测变量之间提出形如 y ≈ f ⁡ ( x , θ ) y\approx f(x;\theta) 的参数化关系，并且只有当某个关系在留出集上胜过标准基线时才被采纳——门槛因法院体系（court family）而异，通常要求 R 2 ≥ 0.5 R^{2}\geq 0.5 且相对基线有一定优势幅度。 每条被采纳的关系（“符号”）都会进入一个持久化账本。

sents.en: The system is a self-improving physical-science runtime (companion paper ( Mao and Zou, 2026 ) ).
sents.zh: 该系统是一个自我改进的物理科学运行时（伴生论文 ( Mao and Zou, 2026 )）。

sents.en: Concretely, it continuously ingests public measurement archives (planetary ephemerides, spectroscopy tables, crystallography databases, climate and geophysical records), proposes parametric relations of the form y ≈ f ⁡ ( x , θ ) y\approx f(x;\theta) between measured variables of one dataset, and admits a relation only if it beats a standard basis on a held-out split—gates vary by court family, typically R 2 ≥ 0.5 R^{2}\geq 0.5 with a margin over the basis.
sents.zh: 具体而言，它持续摄取公开的测量档案（行星星历表、光谱学数据表、晶体学数据库、气候与地球物理记录），在单个数据集的被测变量之间提出形如 y ≈ f ⁡ ( x , θ ) y\approx f(x;\theta) 的参数化关系，并且只有当某个关系在留出集上胜过标准基线时才被采纳——门槛因法院体系（court family）而异，通常要求 R 2 ≥ 0.5 R^{2}\geq 0.5 且相对基线有一定优势幅度。

sents.en: Every admitted relation (“symbol”) enters a persistent ledger.
sents.zh: 每条被采纳的关系（“符号”）都会进入一个持久化账本。

paragraphs.en: We use the word in its classical sense ( Russell and Norvig, 2021 ) : an entity that perceives its environment (measurement archives), acts autonomously on it (admitting, rejecting, registering predictions), and maintains persistent state toward its goal (a ledger of court-verified knowledge). It is a long-running discovery runtime, not a trained model, and not an LLM-based agent in the contemporary harness sense: no language model proposes, admits, or grades any relation in the audited ledger—candidates are parametric forms from symbolic generators, and admission is decided by held-out statistics. A separate coding agent (Acknowledgments) develops the runtime itself under human approval; that activity lies outside the audited loop and is not claimed as the system’s own autonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照经典意义使用这个词（Russell and Norvig, 2021）：智能体是这样一个实体，它感知其环境（测量档案），对其自主行动（接纳、拒绝、登记预测），并为实现其目标而维持持久状态（由法庭验证的知识构成的账本）。 它是一个长期运行的发现运行时，既不是训练出来的模型，也不是当代框架意义上的基于大语言模型的智能体：在被审计的账本中，没有任何语言模型提出、接纳或评判任何关系——候选项来自符号生成器的参数形式，而接纳与否由留出统计决定。 另一个独立的编码智能体（见致谢）在人类批准下开发该运行时本身；这项活动处于被审计的循环之外，并不被声称为该系统自身的自主性。

paragraphs.en: We claim no novelty for the mathematics; it is a Gaussian-code instance of the structure/statistics separation formalized by Kolmogorov’s structure function and algorithmic statistics ( Vereshchagin and Vitányi, 2004 ) , and the noise-floor intuition traces to Shannon. The contribution is that a running discovery system can carry this separation as a live ledger column—and that, read correctly, the column already answers the vetting question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并不宣称这一数学部分具有任何新颖性；它只是由 Kolmogorov 结构函数与算法统计（Vereshchagin 和 Vitányi, 2004）所形式化的结构/统计分离的一个高斯编码实例，而噪声底限的直觉则可追溯到 Shannon。 贡献在于：一个运行中的发现系统能够将这种分离作为一个实时台账列加以承载——而且，只要解读得当，该列本身就已经回答了审查问题。

paragraphs.en: The sharpest case is deliberate. In the week before the audit, a context-embedding predictor for protein secondary-structure content was trained on the agent’s sequence digest—by the development process under human approval, per the agent-scope paragraph above, not by the runtime autonomously—and admitted through the prediction gate as the first “embedding symbol”: held-out R 2 = 0.541 R^{2}=0.541 against a symbolic ceiling of 0.277 0.277 . Its compression ratio is 1.004 1.004 . Under single-metric bookkeeping this admission would read as a law-grade discovery; under the ledger it is what it is—the agent’s best predictor, statistical grade, honestly labeled. The dual-axis correction is now a standing system-level rule: R 2 R^{2} records prediction value, cr records compression value. Concretely, every admission carries the compression ratio as a mandatory ledger field, while the admission-time R 2 R^{2} is preserved in the court artifact each entry’s evidence record links to.

paragraphs.en: This is the self-audit half of the paper’s claim, and we state it plainly: a self-improving discovery system that cannot grade its own knowledge will systematically mistake statistical accumulation for physical understanding. Ours did, measurably, at 86 % 86\% , until an internal instrument—one it had been computing all along—said so.

paragraphs.en: Schmidhuber’s compression-progress principle ( Schmidhuber, 2008 ) motivates discovery agents by compression gains. We share the premise, not the direction: our question is not what compression can drive, but what an already-computed compression column knows about knowledge already banked.
